current_activity: Armeegruppe Student formed (LXXXVIII Corps, II Parachute Corps, WBN) with headquarters north of Lingen (Skizze 4)
notes: Event date: 1945-04-02 (FMS B-414 (Geyer), German p.22-23 (Fold3 image 81-82), Skizze 4 (Fold3 image 132)). Event definition: from 1 April Student takes over the army group left wing as Armeegruppe Student (LXXXVIII Corps east of the IJssel, II Parachute Corps, Wehrmachtbefehlshaber Niederlande); Skizze 4 (2 April) has the A.Gr.St. headquarters north of Lingen. Renamed Army Blumentritt on 10 April. Event support: one source family (FMS, German postwar manuscripts). Location: Lingen (Ems), Niedersachsen (place PL0770) with a precision of 10 km. Location support: Skizze 4 puts the symbol north of Lingen; Lingen is a representative point. Commander: Generaloberst Kurt Student. Review: confidence 0.3 from the rubric (one postwar manuscript by the Army Group H / OB Nordwest operations officer, written in April 1946 at Bruges/Allendorf without full records; 0.5 for a dated place in the text or the command-post list, 0.3 for approximate dates, sectors, representative points and sketch positions); added in the FMS Fold3 reading of 3 November 2026. Location approximate: a position read from a sketch map at 1:1,000,000 (map row, 0.3; never outranks a text row). Context: C1223 dates the creation of Army Blumentritt to 6 April; B-414 has it grow from Armeegruppe Student (1-2 April). Review (small-fixes-1114, roadmap 351, 14 November 2026, approved by Scott): this row replaces C7968 (retired): claim id old value C7968 (unit GER-ARMY-BLUMT, unit_name Army Blumentritt (Armee Blumentritt), echelon army), new value C9453 (unit GER-AG-STUDT, unit_name Armeegruppe Student (Army Group Student), echelon army_group); reason: the row is the formation of Armeegruppe Student, which now has its own unit record, and a claim id is never reused for another unit (check_claim_ids), so the row was retired and re-entered with a new id. Date, place, confidence, sources and text are unchanged; Army Blumentritt keeps its other rows and the staff link is stated in the notes (B-414: Student's staff is given the Weser defence on 6 April and Blumentritt takes over on 10 April).
